notes.title: Development Update — Next Chapter Preview!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45140156/96b78c09b9ef94924c66862d6a67a4066c456621.png[/img]
Hi everyone!

Just wanted to share a quick update on how development is going. I’ve set a personal goal to release new updates every 2 to 3 months, and so far, things are moving along right on schedule.

Let’s talk about what’s coming next.

What’s in the next update?

The upcoming update will focus heavily on Chloe and your second date with her — if you're following the Stranger path.
Depending on your relationship with Chloe, the date will unfold in two very different ways:
[list]
[*] One more romantic and emotional
[*] The other more intense and seductive
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45140156/02cf7592dcaf47a162231fb65e33907c5d7d50c7.png[/img]

You’ll also see further development in your story with Emily. 

As I’ve mentioned before, the game is now shifting from the “getting to know the characters” phase into the “action” phase .
From now on, each update will include increasingly spicy content, with scenes that reflect your evolving relationships and choices.

I'll be posting more details soon, including:
[list]
[*] An estimated release date
[*] A breakdown of how much new content and animations to expect
[/list]
Thank you all so much for your continued support, kind messages, and patience.
Every comment, and bit of feedback truly helps keep me motivated and inspired.

notes.title: Reclaiming the Lost: New Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45140156/478d1d0635c768e8048024ce9e2e92e13d7088b4.png[/img]
We’re very excited to bring you a new update for Reclaiming the Lost.
This update introduces a new chapter packed with emotional moments, and intimate encounters.
Here’s what’s included:

- Grace — After moving into a new apartment, Grace is trying to rebuild her life. Can the MC help her finally let go of her late husband and start something new?
- Chloe — Depending on the path you’ve chosen, you’ll experience one of two very different — and very hot — events with Chloe. Each route reveals a different side of her.
- Evelyn — It’s time to make a final decision: will you stay loyal to Bob, or cross a line and become Evelyn’s secret lover?
- Olivia — A mysterious girl appears, and your encounter with her may be more than just a coincidence...


[i]From the Developer:

After a bit of a longer break, updates will now be released more frequently — roughly every 2 to 3 months. Each one will be large in scope, featuring around 700+ new renders, new choices, and deeper story progression.

Thank you for your patience and continued support — we're just getting started.[/i]
